$about: Which model each AI role uses, and through which provider (pipeline/src/roles.mjs reads this; GLOSSARY.md: Model policy). Repository variables AI_MODEL_<ROLE> and AI_MODEL override it for a trial ('model', 'alias' or 'provider:model'); empty them to roll back.

anthropic.$about: Claude through the subscription token (secret CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN). The default.

anthropic-api.$about: Claude through an API key (secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, passed to claude-agent as api-key): pay per token, separate from the subscription.

bedrock.$about: Claude on Amazon Bedrock through GitHub's OIDC identity (no stored AWS key): variables AWS_ROLE_ARN and AWS_REGION. Add Bedrock's model ids (or inference profile ids) for the aliases you use before choosing it.

vertex.$about: Claude on Google Vertex AI through workload identity federation: variables GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER, GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID and CLOUD_ML_REGION. Add Vertex's model ids for the aliases you use before choosing it.

gateway.$about: An Anthropic-compatible gateway (LiteLLM and the like): variable AI_GATEWAY_URL, its key as secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Anthropic does not support Claude Code on other vendors' models: a model whose id does not name Claude is allowed only for the review and plan roles.

review.$why: Haiku made confident false Salesforce blockers on PR #144 (Apex), each costing a round: Sonnet reviews code, access and automation; Haiku only a change with none of them (jev.mjs isDeclarativeOnly).

ui-test.$why: Sonnet, not Haiku: both of story #200's Haiku runs used every turn, and a failed writer run costs ~15 Actions minutes (a runner holding the org's lane), far more than the price difference. The UI writer's 40 turns ran out on story #193 without it looking at its failure screenshot: 30, and it is told to stop and report before the end.
